title: New public Shopify app built on the REST Admin API is blocked from the App Store
symptoms: A new public app built on REST Admin calls cannot pass App Store submission
Newer platform features exist only in GraphQL with no REST endpoint
Tutorials and older SDK examples use REST resources that the reference marks legacy
cause: Shopify made the REST Admin API legacy on 2024-10-01 and since 2025-04-01 requires new public apps to use only the GraphQL Admin API.
fix: Build new public apps on the GraphQL Admin API from the start and treat REST code samples as legacy.
apply:
const client = new shopify.clients.Graphql({ session })
const res = await client.request(`query { shop { name } }`)
affected: New public apps submitted on or after 2025-04-01; existing REST apps keep working but get no new features
